text:
maya: FYI opened a PR rearranging the SOC2 evidence section to explicitly call out immutable evidence flows and how deletion/legal-hold exceptions are handled. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842

jack: Nice, thanks. Does it cover both audit-log export semantics and the evidence export playbook we give to customers? I want to avoid gaps where people assume we can trivially remove records after export.

maya: Good call — I added a short playbook subsection and an example command for exports. Still need help with wording around 'immutable' vs 'append-only by policy'.

oliver: From legal — please avoid absolute phrasing like "we never delete". Suggest: "Audit data is stored in an append-only system by default; deletions are only performed via documented retention/TTL policies or legal hold processes and are subject to compliance review." That should reduce risk.

maya: Reword applied in PR, thanks. 

sophia: We also need to update the SDK snippet for evidence exports (customers using old /v1/export will be impacted). Proposed CLI snippet: 

```
# export evidence for tenant
redwoodctl evidence export --tenant-id t_123 --since 2024-01-01 --format jsonl --out ./evidence-2024-01.jsonl
```
Add a note about the export being a point-in-time snapshot; it doesn't change retention.

jack: Can you add a short example JSON line for the audit event shape so docs and SDK are aligned? e.g.:

```
{"ts":"2025-02-10T18:33:00Z","tenant":"t_123","event":"model.generate","immutable":true,"meta":{"route":"/v1/generate"}}
```
oliver: Maybe rename field to "retention_locked"? "immutable" could be interpreted as a technical guarantee rather than a policy flag. Either works if we document it clearly.

sophia: We're using "retention_locked" in runtime metadata today. I'll change snippet to match runtime so customers see the exact key.

maya: Great — I'll update the PR text to reference runtime field names and add a migration note for SDKs (v1 -> v2 export differences). Also added a short FAQ entry for legal-hold vs TTL.

jack: One more thing — linkcheck found one stale link to the export CLI in the onboarding guide. I'll paste the failing link in the PR comments.

maya: Found it, thanks — fixed the link and rebased.

deploy-bot: docs-ci: build passed for PR #842 (:white_check_mark:)

oliver: LGTM from legal on wording. No blocking comments.

sophia: I'll open a tiny SDK PR to update examples and a changelog line. ETA EOD.

maya: Thanks everyone — assigning myself to merge once SDK snippet PR is green. Targeting merge tomorrow morning so we can ship the migration note with SDK release. :rocket:
